subject: Re: On‑prem procurement: IAC test evidence & contract checkpoints
messages:
From: itprocure@acme.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: secops@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: On‑prem stack: procurement kick off & evidence needs

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking time today. As we move toward the PO and SOW for the on‑prem Private deployment, Procurement and SecOps need a short package so legal can clear commercial redlines. At minimum we need: 1) a manifest of IaC modules (Terraform/Helm/Ansible) you intend to deploy on the Air‑gapped cluster, 2) a mapping of which artifacts are signed and where (artifact registry / local registry), and 3) a SOC‑2 evidence index for runtime logging/audit.

Can your team produce a one‑page proofpack + sample artifact list (CSV or spreadsheet) by EOD Monday? Also, we have a couple commercial items that may require legal tweaks — I'll attach initial redlines after I talk to contracting.

Appreciate it,
Leah Conway
ACME IT Procurement
itprocure@acme.com

Attachment: procurement-sow-questions.txt (stub)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: itprocure@acme.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-13T10:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: On‑prem stack: procurement kick off & evidence needs

Hi Leah — thanks, we can put that together. Quick clarifications so we scope the deliverable correctly:

- "Manifest of IaC modules": we will include names, Git repo paths, pinned tags, and which runtime (Terraform modules, Helm charts, Ansible roles) are used for networking, bastion/egress, registry mirroring, and the Redwood runtime.
- "Artifact signing": we use container images signed via cosign and an internal provenance file for Helm artifacts. We'll list registries and signing keys (public thumbprints only).
- "SOC‑2 evidence index": we'll surface the runtime logs/audit artifacts we can provide (connection audits, KMS logs, operator access logs). Note some items require a legal NDA addendum — if you want raw logs we need to confirm retention/PII redaction rules.

Proposed deliverables (by Mon EOD):
1) iac-proofpack-manifest.csv (module, repo, tag, purpose)
2) soc2-evidence-index.txt (supported evidence and how to request extracts)
3) redlines_acme_20261113.pdf (contract comments we expect to discuss)

Kimberly, can you take point on the proofpack CSV? Marissa, can you prepare the evidence index and note anything that will need legal escalation? Leah, if you can send the contracting redlines as they arrive I will route to our legal ops.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Attachments: none

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: itprocure@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-14T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: On‑prem stack: procurement kick off & evidence needs

Hi all — rapid update and attached draft index.

(see attached) soc2-evidence-index.txt — high level mapping:
- Control CC‑7 (change management): link to PR audit logs and git history for Terraform modules.
- Control AL‑3 (access logs): operator access log retention policy + sample KMS audit export format.
- Control SE‑6 (network config reviews): helm values templates and network security group change logs.

Notes:
- For air‑gapped clusters we can provide signed manifests and the cosign public keys. We cannot export customer private keys or full live logs without an NDA addendum; we can provide redacted extracts and a signed attestation.
- I added an "evidence request pattern" so ACME can request extracts via a ticketing flow and we can track chain of custody.

Olga — attached is the evidence index plus a small sample iac-proofpack-manifest.csv. I left placeholders for the registry thumbprints and a short checklist for the deployment runbook we typically hand to customers.

Marissa Cole
Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: soc2-evidence-index.txt, iac-proofpack-manifest.csv

From: itprocure@acme.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: secops@acme.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T16:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: On‑prem stack: procurement kick off & evidence needs

Hi Olga / team — front office readout: procurement reviewed your packet, thanks. A few commercial redlines surfaced (see attached) around liability caps and data residency obligations; legal also asked for a short summary of the CI/CD gating we use to promote Helm/Terraform artifacts into the air‑gapped artifact mirror. SecOps confirms the evidence index looks reasonable but want your runbook checklist added for initial bootstrap (bastion/registry mirroring/first‑boot validation).

Action items we want before we circulate to Legal: 
- 1) one‑page runbook checklist for the first bootstrap (approx. 10 bullets) — Kimberly to own
- 2) CI/CD gating summary (what automated gates must pass: signed artifact, vulnerability scan, provenance) — Olga/Kim
- 3) Response on whether raw operator logs can be exported under an NDA addendum (SecOps) — Marissa

We'd like these by COB Wednesday 2026‑11‑18 to keep the deal timeline intact. If that's tight we can push contract signature one week.

Thanks,
Leah Conway
ACME IT Procurement
itprocure@acme.com

Attachments: acme-contract-redlines-20261116.pdf
